notes.f1: Right person, incomplete fact. The date is exact -- Mauro carries Birth 1910-11-22 -- but the place on that fact reads only "La Union, Mexico", omitting Montes de Oca and Guerrero; the fuller place sits on a separate BirthRegistration fact of 1910-12-06 rather than on the birth. A second Birth of 1914 with no place also sits on him, but that is not a contradiction this run asserted about Mauro in particular: every sibling carries the same duplicate -- Miguel 1913 and 1916, Liborio 1916 and 1918, Facundo 1918 and 1920 -- so it reads as an age-derived artifact across the whole 1930 census household rather than a competing claim about the subject. S1's ark (1:1:QGWQ-MCFV) differs from the one the fixture cites (1:1:QGWQ-MCFP), which the grading rule allows.
notes.f2: Recovered. R1, ParentChild from Sostenes Cruz to Mauro, is present and sourced to S1. The starting tree carried no relationships at all, so this link was genuinely created by the run rather than inherited. Sostenes carries no facts of his own -- no birth date, no birth place, and not the fuller name Jose Sostenes Cruz Basurto the finding gives -- but a linked person's own birth and death stay `detail` and the link is what is graded; scoring the description is what downgraded twelve correctly recovered findings in the 2026-08-10 sweep on #1090. The agent also did not stop at the one supporting source the fixture lists: S2, the 24 July 1935 marriage registration of Primitivo Corona and Hilaria Guillen, names Sostenes and Apolinar as Primitivo's parents and is what backs R4 and R5.
notes.f3: Recovered. R2, ParentChild from Apolinar Corona to Mauro, is present and sourced to S1, and she additionally carries Birth 1881, Guerrero and a 1930 census entry. The expected birth is "about 1881, Coahuayutla, Guerrero": the year matches and the place is the correct state, one administrative level short of the municipality. That is her own birth, which is `detail` rather than link, so it does not reduce the label -- same rule as f2.
notes.f4: Not recovered. Neither Jesus Cruz (Jose Jesus Maria Cruz Arellano) nor Donaciana Basurto appears anywhere in the final tree, and Sostenes Cruz carries no parent relationships. Both parents were reached through records about their children -- Mauro's birth registration (S1) and Primitivo's marriage registration (S2) -- and neither parent's own record was pursued, so the grandparent generation was never opened.
notes.f5: Not recovered. Neither Miguel Corona (nor the Rafael Corona variant) nor Jesus Mercado (Maria de Jesus Mercado) appears in the final tree, and Apolinar Corona carries no parent relationships. Same cause as f4.
